Best of Game

Released December 1, 2002 · 9 cards

Best of Game is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on December 1, 2002. It has 9 cards. It includes 8 Pokémon, 1 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
